ei.title: Small Changes for a Better Planet
ei.subject: 수능특강

fullPassage: There are some pretty big lifestyle changes you can choose to make if you want to help the planet. For instance, you could follow a plant-based diet, or you could pledge to go zero-waste. If you're surrounded by people who are making these drastic changes, you might feel pressured into following suit: you might feel that if you don't make these changes, your efforts to save the planet are inadequate. Despite what you might hear, a plant-based diet or zero-waste living is not necessarily an all-or-nothing venture. Reducing your meat and dairy intake a little is better than not doing so at all; buying fruit, veg and grains loose when you can is better than always buying them wrapped in plastic. The fact is, you don't have to follow a vegan or a zero-waste lifestyle perfectly to make a difference. Making little changes where you can and how you can is what truly counts.

questions.passage: There are some pretty big lifestyle changes you can choose to make if you want to help the planet. For instance, you could follow a plant-based diet, or you could pledge to go zero-waste. If you're surrounded by people who are making these (A)[minor / drastic] changes, you might feel pressured into following suit: you might feel that if you don't make these changes, your efforts to save the planet are (B)[inadequate / sufficient]. Despite what you might hear, a plant-based diet or zero-waste living is not necessarily an all-or-nothing venture. Reducing your meat and dairy intake a little is better than not doing so at all; buying fruit, veg and grains loose when you can is better than always buying them wrapped in plastic. The fact is, you don't have to follow a vegan or a zero-waste lifestyle (C)[poorly / perfectly] to make a difference. Making little changes where you can and how you can is what truly counts.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① drastic - inadequate - perfectly = 원문과 일치 ←정답
❌ ② minor(사소한): '급격한' 변화라는 원문과 반대
❌ ③ sufficient(충분한): 노력이 '부적절하다'는 원문과 반대
❌ ④ poorly(형편없이): '완벽하게' 따르지 않아도 된다는 원문과 반대
det.tip: drastic changes(급격한 변화), efforts are inadequate(노력이 부족한), follow perfectly(완벽하게 따르다)가 핵심 3어이다.

questions.passage: There are some pretty big lifestyle changes you can choose to make if you want to help the planet. For instance, you could follow a plant-based diet, or you could (A)[refuse / pledge] to go zero-waste. If you're surrounded by people who are making these drastic changes, you might feel (B)[encouraged / pressured] into following suit: you might feel that if you don't make these changes, your efforts to save the planet are inadequate. Despite what you might hear, a plant-based diet or zero-waste living is not necessarily an all-or-nothing venture. Reducing your meat and dairy intake a little is better than not doing so at all; buying fruit, veg and grains loose when you can is better than always buying them wrapped in plastic. The fact is, you don't have to follow a vegan or a zero-waste lifestyle perfectly to make a (C)[difference / mistake]. Making little changes where you can and how you can is what truly counts.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① refuse — pressured — difference: (A) refuse(거부하다): 원문은 pledge(서약하다)
❌ ② pledge — encouraged — difference: (B) encouraged(격려받는): 원문은 pressured(압박받는)
✅ ③ pledge — pressured — difference = 원문과 일치 ←정답
❌ ④ pledge — pressured — mistake: (C) mistake(실수): 원문은 difference(차이를 만들다)
det.tip: pledge to go zero-waste(제로웨이스트 서약하다), feel pressured(압박받다), make a difference(차이를 만들다)가 핵심이다.

questions.passage: There are some pretty big lifestyle changes you can choose to make if you want to help the planet. For instance, you could follow a plant-based diet, or you could pledge to go zero-waste. If you're surrounded by people who are making these drastic changes, you might feel pressured into (A)[following suit / standing out]: you might feel that if you don't make these changes, your efforts to save the planet are inadequate. Despite what you might hear, a plant-based diet or zero-waste living is not necessarily an all-or-nothing (B)[necessity / venture]. Reducing your meat and dairy intake a little is better than not doing so at all; buying fruit, veg and grains loose when you can is better than always buying them wrapped in plastic. The fact is, you don't have to follow a vegan or a zero-waste lifestyle perfectly to make a difference. Making little changes where you can and how you can is what truly (C)[fails / counts].
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① standing out — venture — counts: (A) standing out(돋보이기): 원문은 following suit(따라하기)
❌ ② following suit — necessity — counts: (B) necessity(필수): 원문은 venture(모험)
❌ ③ following suit — venture — fails: (C) fails(실패하다): 원문은 counts(중요하다)
✅ ④ following suit — venture — counts = 원문과 일치 ←정답
det.tip: following suit(남을 따라하다), an all-or-nothing venture(전부 아니면 전무의 모험), what truly counts(정말 중요한 것)가 본문 논리의 핵심이다.

Despite what you might hear, a plant-based diet or zero-waste living is not necessarily an all-or-nothing venture. Reducing your meat and dairy intake a little is better than not doing so at all; buying fruit, veg and grains loose when you can is better than always buying them wrapped in plastic. The fact is, you don't have to follow a vegan or a zero-waste lifestyle perfectly to make a ④<u>difference</u>. Making little changes where you can and how you can is what truly counts.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① lifestyle(생활양식): 꽤 큰 '생활양식' 변화라는 의미로 적절
✅ ② drastic(급격한): 이런 '급격한' 변화를 하는 사람들에 둘러싸이면이라는 의미로 적절
❌ ③ adequate → inadequate: 이런 변화를 하지 않으면 노력이 '부적절하다(inadequate)'고 느낄 수 있다는 원문과 반대 ←정답
✅ ④ difference(차이): '차이를 만들기 위해' 완벽하게 따를 필요 없다는 의미로 적절
det.tip: your efforts are inadequate(노력이 불충분하다)와 adequate(충분한)는 정반대이다.

Despite what you might hear, a plant-based diet or zero-waste living is not necessarily an all-or-nothing venture. ②<u>Increasing</u> your meat and dairy intake a little is better than not doing so at all; buying fruit, veg and grains ③<u>loose</u> when you can is better than always buying them ④<u>wrapped</u> in plastic. det.analysis:

✅ ③ loose(낱개로): 과일과 채소를 '낱개로' 사는 것이 낫다는 의미로 적절
✅ ④ wrapped(포장된): 플라스틱에 '포장된' 채로 사는 것보다 낫다는 의미로 적절

det.korean: (A) 시도, 모험적 사업 / (B) 위험을 무릅쓰고 나아가다
det.analysis:
✅ ① (A) 시도 - (B) 위험을 무릅쓰고 나아가다: (A)에서 venture는 명사로 '모험적 시도/사업'을, (B)에서는 동사로 '위험을 감수하며 진출하다'를 뜻한다 ←정답
❌ ② (A) 위험 - (B) 시도: (A)에서 venture는 '위험'이 아니라 '시도/사업'이고, (B)에서는 동사임
❌ ③ (A) 시도 - (B) 시도: (B)에서 venture into는 동사로 '진출하다'이지 명사 '시도'가 아님
❌ ④ (A) 모험심 - (B) 투자하다: (A)에서 '모험심'은 심리 상태이고 venture는 행위/사업을 뜻함
det.tip: venture(명사) = 모험적 시도/사업. venture into(동사) = 위험을 무릅쓰고 ~에 진출하다. 품사에 따라 의미가 다르다.

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "extreme and sudden; likely to have a strong or far-reaching effect"

det.korean: 급격한, 과감한 — 강하고 광범위한 영향을 미칠 가능성이 있는
det.analysis:
❌ ① inadequate(불충분한): 양이나 질이 부족하다는 뜻이지 '극단적이고 갑작스러운'과 무관
✅ ② drastic(급격한): 극단적이고 갑작스러우며 강한 영향을 미친다는 정의에 정확히 부합 ←정답
❌ ③ loose(느슨한): 단단히 고정되지 않은이라는 뜻이지 정의와 무관
❌ ④ vegan(채식주의의): 동물성 제품을 배제하는 식단이지 정의와 무관
det.tip: drastic changes(급격한 변화)는 'extreme and sudden' 변화를 뜻한다.

questions.passage: Despite what you might hear, a plant-based diet or zero-waste living is not __________ (necessary) an all-or-nothing venture.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어) (영어로)

det.analysis: 'is not ___ an all-or-nothing venture'에서 명사구를 수식하는 부사가 필요하므로 형용사 'necessary'를 부사 'necessarily(반드시)'로 바꿔야 한다.
det.tip: necessary(필요한, 형용사) → necessarily(반드시, 부사). 'not necessarily'는 '반드시 ~은 아니다'라는 관용 표현이다.

questions.passage: If you're surrounded by people who are making these drastic changes, you might feel __________ (pressure) into following suit.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어) (영어로)

det.analysis: 'feel ___ into following suit'에서 'feel + 과거분사' 구문으로 '~하도록 압박받다'는 의미이므로 명사 'pressure'를 과거분사 'pressured'로 바꿔야 한다. feel pressured into ~ing = ~하도록 압박감을 느끼다.
det.tip: pressure(압력, 명사) → pressured(압박받는, 과거분사). 'feel pressured into ~ing'은 '~하도록 압박감을 느끼다'라는 뜻이다.

questions.passage: There are some pretty big lifestyle changes you can choose to make if you want to help the planet. For instance, you could follow a plant-based diet, or you could pledge to go zero-waste. If you're surrounded by people who are making these drastic changes, you might feel pressured into __________: you might feel that if you don't make these changes, your efforts to save the planet are inadequate. Despite what you might hear, a plant-based diet or zero-waste living is not necessarily an all-or-nothing venture. Reducing your meat and dairy intake a little is better than not doing so at all; buying fruit, veg and grains loose when you can is better than always buying them wrapped in plastic. The fact is, you don't have to follow a vegan or a zero-waste lifestyle perfectly to make a difference. Making little changes where you can and how you can is what truly counts.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 따라하기 — 주변 사람들의 급격한 변화를 따라 하도록 압박받는다는 의미
det.analysis:
❌ ① making a difference(차이를 만들기): 글 후반의 결론이지 압박받는 행동이 아님
❌ ② saving the planet(지구를 구하기): 글의 전체 목적이지 구체적으로 압박받는 행동이 아님
❌ ③ going zero-waste(제로웨이스트 하기): 급격한 변화의 한 예시이지 '따라하기' 행동 자체가 아님
✅ ④ following suit(따라하기): 주변의 급격한 변화를 '따라 하도록' 압박받는다는 문맥에 부합 ←정답
det.tip: feel pressured into following suit(따라하도록 압박감을 느끼다)에서 following suit는 '남이 하는 대로 따라하다'라는 관용어이다.

questions.passage: There are some pretty big lifestyle changes you can choose to make if you want to help the planet. For instance, you could follow a plant-based diet, or you could pledge to go zero-waste. If you're surrounded by people who are making these drastic changes, you might feel pressured into following suit: you might feel that if you don't make these changes, your efforts to save the planet are inadequate. Despite what you might hear, a plant-based diet or zero-waste living is not necessarily __________. Reducing your meat and dairy intake a little is better than not doing so at all; buying fruit, veg and grains loose when you can is better than always buying them wrapped in plastic. The fact is, you don't have to follow a vegan or a zero-waste lifestyle perfectly to make a difference. Making little changes where you can and how you can is what truly counts.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 전부 아니면 전무의 모험 — 식물 기반 식단이나 제로웨이스트가 반드시 그렇지는 않다는 논지
det.analysis:
❌ ① a plant-based diet(식물 기반 식단): 이것은 예시이지 '반드시 ~이 아니다'의 빈칸 내용이 아님
❌ ② a way to help the planet(지구를 돕는 방법): 글 전체 주제이지만, '반드시 ~이 아니다'에 넣으면 주제와 모순
✅ ③ an all-or-nothing venture(전부 아니면 전무의 모험): 식물 기반이나 제로웨이스트가 '반드시 전부 아니면 전무는 아니다'라는 핵심 논지에 부합 ←정답
❌ ④ a little change you can make(당신이 할 수 있는 작은 변화): 긍정적 의미인데 'not necessarily'와 연결하면 논리 모순
det.tip: not necessarily an all-or-nothing venture(반드시 전부 아니면 전무의 모험은 아니다)는 이 글의 핵심 주장이다.
